message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "Build XLCore"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  Build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./src/XIVLauncher.Core/
    concurrency:
      group: "${{ github.ref }}"
      cancel-in-progress: true
    env:
      GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: 10.0.x

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget/packages
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('src/XIVLauncher.Core/**/*.csproj', 'src/XIVLauncher.Core/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: Dotnet Restore
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Dotnet Build (Linux)
        run: dotnet publish -r linux-x64 --sc --configuration Release --no-restore -o ./dist/XIVLauncher.Core

      - name: Dotnet Build (Windows)
        run: dotnet publish -r win-x64 --sc --configuration Release -o ./dist/XIVLauncher.Core-win10x64

      - name: Dotnet Test
        run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `dotnet restore` on every invocation without caching the NuGet package cache (`~/.nuget/packages`). Pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE supports caching dependency downloads to save CI resources while preserving all required checks. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs every run, and cache inputs can include the runner OS plus csproj/lockfile. No contraindications apply: no equivalent cache exists, and NuGet package content is version-pinned and trusted. The change adds a single cache step before restore; checkout, setup, both publish builds, and the test step are unchanged, so build and test coverage is preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
